items.title: Draisaitl scores twice, McDavid has 3 assists to extend streak and Oilers beat skidding Canucks 4-2
items.summary: — Leon Draisaitl had two goals and an assist, Connor McDavid added three more assists and the Edmonton Oilers beat the struggling Vancouver Canucks 4-2 on Saturday night.

items.title: Oilers beat skidding Canucks 4-2
items.summary: Vancouver is 1-14-1 since a 2-1 start. The Canucks host Philadelphia on Monday.

items.title: Canucks at Oilers projected lineups
items.summary: Chytil (upper body) and Demko (hip) were listed as injured. Bains was expected in for Quillan and Schenn for Mancini.

VGK.headline: In progress at 5 PM ET: Vegas led Buffalo 1-0 on a Mitch Marner goal. The Golden Knights finish a road trip at Buffalo on Sunday after a 2-1 win at Detroit on Thursday.
VGK.game: Next: Sun Nov 08, 3:30 PM ET at BUF, KeyBank Center (MSG-B, SCRIPPS, SN1, TVAS). Carter Hart projected to start.

items.title: Golden Knights bring winning streak into home matchup with the Predators
items.summary: Nashville Predators (10-4-5, in the Central Division) vs. Vegas Golden Knights (13-5-2, in the Pacific Division)

items.title: Stone moves within 2 points of breaking Vegas’ career scoring record in 5-3 win over Utah
items.summary: — Mark Stone had an early assist to move within two points of breaking Vegas’ career scoring record, Ivan Barbashev scored twice in the second period and the Golden Knights beat the Utah Mammoth 5-3 on Wednesday night.

items.title: Vegas plays Utah following Hertl's 2-goal showing
items.summary: Utah Mammoth (10-7-1, in the Central Division) vs. Vegas Golden Knights (12-5-2, in the Pacific Division)

items.title: Hart projected to start at Buffalo
items.summary: The Hockey News projected Carter Hart (5-3-2, .900) in goal with lines unchanged. Vegas is 5-2-2 on the road.

items.title: Connelly scores in three straight
items.summary: Trevor Connelly has seven goals and has scored in three straight games. Jack Eichel leads the team with 23 points.

items.title: Olofsson back in 2-1 win at Detroit
items.summary: Victor Olofsson returned from injury on Nov. 5. Braeden Bowman scored in the win.

items.title: Tomas Hertl scores twice as Golden Knights beat Sabres 4-1 for third straight win
items.summary: — Tomas Hertl scored two goals and the Vegas Golden Knights won their third straight game, 4-1 over the Buffalo Sabres on Sunday.

WPG.headline: The Jets host Tampa Bay on Sunday after a 6-2 win over Vancouver on Thursday.
WPG.game: Next: Sun Nov 08, 6:00 PM ET vs TBL, Canada Life Centre (TSN3, The Spot). Stuart Skinner projected to start.

items.title: Winnipeg visits Chicago after Mercer's 2-goal game
items.summary: Winnipeg Jets (9-8-3, in the Central Division) vs. Chicago Blackhawks (5-13-1, in the Central Division)

items.title: Mark Scheifele and Dawson Mercer score 2 goals each as Jets roar past Stars 8-3
items.summary: — Mark Scheifele had two goals and an assist, and Dawson Mercer had his second consecutive two-goal game as the Winnipeg Jets rode a five-goal second period and scored the final six goals to rally past the Dallas Stars 8-3 on Thursday night.

items.title: Jets play the Stars after Mercer's 2-goal performance
items.summary: Winnipeg Jets (8-8-3, in the Central Division) vs. Dallas Stars (10-5-2, in the Central Division)

items.title: Connor Hellebuyck booed pregame in Winnipeg return as Jets go on to beat Devils
items.summary: Although he did not play Tuesday night in his return to Winnipeg after being traded to New Jersey, goaltender Connor Hellebuyck was booed when he took the ice for the Devils' pregame warmup.

items.title: Mercer, Connor each score twice to lift Jets to an emotional 4-2 win over Devils
items.summary: — Dawson Mercer and Kyle Connor each scored twice to lead the Winnipeg Jets to an emotional 4-2 victory over the New Jersey Devils on Tuesday night.

items.title: Connor Hellebuyck discusses why he wanted out of Winnipeg
items.summary: Connor Hellebuyck talks a little bit about why he wanted out of Winnipeg.

items.title: Jets disappointed ex-goalie Connor Hellebuyck sitting out
items.summary: The Jets are disappointed they won't get closure for the departure of ex-goalie Connor Hellebuyck as he won't be starting for the Devils when they play in Winnipeg on Tuesday.

items.title: Devils visit the Jets after Meier's 2-goal game
items.summary: New Jersey Devils (13-5, in the Metropolitan Division) vs. Winnipeg Jets (7-8-3, in the Central Division)

WSH.headline: The Capitals beat Florida 4-3 at home on Saturday to end a two-game losing streak.
WSH.game: Next: Tue Nov 10, 7:00 PM ET at Ottawa Senators, Canadian Tire Centre (MNMT, RDS2, TSN5). Starter not announced.

items.title: Metropolitan Division foes meet when Washington hosts New Jersey
items.summary: New Jersey Devils (14-6, in the Metropolitan Division) vs. Washington Capitals (10-7, in the Metropolitan Division)

items.title: Kolyachonok scores go-ahead goal, Hellebuyck makes 26 saves as Devils beat Capitals 5-2
items.summary: — Vladislav Kolyachonok scored the go-ahead goal early in the third period and Connor Hellebuyck made 26 saves as the New Jersey Devils beat the Washington Capitals 5-2 on Thursday night in the first of a two-game set.

items.title: Capitals visit the Devils after shootout win
items.summary: Washington Capitals (10-6, in the Metropolitan Division) vs. New Jersey Devils (13-6, in the Metropolitan Division)

items.title: Hutson's goal 74 seconds into overtime lifts Capitals past Senators 3-2
items.summary: — Cole Hutson’s goal 74 seconds into overtime, set up by Alex Ovechkin, gave the Washington Capitals to a 3-2 win over the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night.

items.title: Senators' Cousins out 7-10 days after legal hit from Caps' Chychrun
items.summary: Senators forward Nick Cousins will be out for a week to 10 days following a thunderous hit by Capitals defenseman Jakob Chychrun  that was ruled as legal during Tuesday night's game.

items.title: Ovechkin says Russians want to play for country, doesn't weigh in on worlds
items.summary: Alex Ovechkin didn't weigh in on CAS' decision to allow Russian players back in hockey worlds, but said they just want to represent their country.

items.title: Senators and Capitals face off in Eastern Conference action
items.summary: Washington Capitals (9-6, in the Metropolitan Division) vs. Ottawa Senators (11-6-1, in the Atlantic Division)

items.title: Capitals rally with three straight, hold off Panthers
items.summary: Jack St. Ivany scored his first NHL goal and Alex Tuch, Aliaksei Protas and Pierre-Luc Dubois also scored in a 4-3 win. Logan Thompson made 27 saves and Tom Wilson got a boarding major and game misconduct for a hit on Sandis Vilmanis.
